assumptions.activation: Automatic eligibility after the declared session delay; fee paid once at eligibility, only after passing; readiness is the next open session
assumptions.attempt_law: Uniform empirical joint distribution of independent component outcome/session-duration pairs; stationary IID fresh-account retries, no retained block across retries

assumptions.chain_rng: PCG64 with SeedSequence([chain_seed, path_index]); input order never changes path streams; no paired-inference claim
assumptions.distribution: Inverse empirical CDF quantiles; equal-weight declared start-date cohort
assumptions.legacy_chain: Existing component retained-block chain diagnostics are preserved separately, never used as IID calendar objectives
assumptions.time: Local civil date difference from purchase to first usable funded session; includes initial weekend/closure wait, failures, retry delay, activation delay and readiness wait; not 24-hour UTC durations

provenance.chain_guard: 10,000 attempts; provider-specific computational horizon; aborted chains return no per-path censoring count

strategy.description: PowerLanguage VWAP pullback: close-latched opening-range break, VWAP retest/reclaim, confirmed pivot target, pivot or pullback stop, ADX elevation/decay gates, fixed or risk sizing. Chicago time; full-session 1-minute close-labelled bars. Next-bar Open market fills; brackets start after the entry bar, stop first if both levels hit. With EOD flatten on, the instrument's reviewed calendar supplies the scheduled close without future bars. Submit flatten the configured minutes earlier (default five, bounded by the EOD cutoff), fill next observed Open; no entries at/after the cutoff.

session_flattening.cutoff_rule: min(eod_flat_time, scheduled session close minus close_buffer_minutes)
session_flattening.fill: next observed bar Open after the cutoff with adverse slippage and commissions; brackets through the cutoff bar retain priority
session_flattening.fill_timestamp: containing bar close label; not a measured tick timestamp
session_flattening.full_close: block entries in the session; evening reopening is the following session
session_flattening.missing_cutoff_bar: submit at the first observed close at/after cutoff; require a subsequent Open by scheduled close
session_flattening.outside_coverage: reject; never infer regular hours or an early close from price bars
session_flattening.session_boundary: 17:00 to 16:00, labelled by local ending date
session_flattening.truncated_session: never changes scheduled cutoff; ordinary end_of_data policy remains explicit

commission_simulation.explanation: Retains source net costs, normalized to the source instrument when identified. Source instrument is unidentified or source-cost mode was selected; broker MNQ commission has not been applied.

excursion_input.cost_contract: Saved net P&L includes source costs. Original costs reconcile before the separately recorded simulation commission treatment; no duplicate source-cost deduction.

source.excursion_provenance: Held OHLC account-equity excursion bounds, including entry costs and realized exit costs once. Uses the conservative MAE upper bound; target-exit ordering may be ambiguous. These are bar observations, not measured tick MAE/MFE. Observed opening gaps and actual exit-cost jumps can overshoot a DLL and breach the account floor. Other intrabar DLL fills assume the threshold price; unobserved tick gaps and liquidity are not modeled.
source.filtering: The portal passes all matched entry rows unchanged; AlphaQuest groups Chicago entry timestamps into CME session days, retaining zero-trade weekdays.

native_risk.policy: Held OHLC equity bounds including entry costs and final net costs; conservative MAE upper bound. Not tick measurements.

phase_suitability.scaling: Linear MNQ exposure scenario on a saved fixed-quantity path; liquidity/size-dependent fills are not resimulated.

uncertainty.calendar_interval_scope: Nominal 95% conditional MC interval; not future uncertainty or a frontier certificate.
uncertainty.future_uncertainty: Historical sampling, model/rule uncertainty and future regime changes are not covered
uncertainty.interpretation: Nominal Monte Carlo intervals conditional on saved source/model. Calendar intervals condition on fitted empirical attempt law; they exclude first-stage fitting error. No simultaneous or paired dominance certification.

calculations.dominance: estimated point estimates; robust dominance not established
calculations.precision_interpretation: Differences are A minus B, paired by saved path and start cohort. Normal approximate Bonferroni 95% intervals cover declared pairs and both objectives. Conditional simulation error only; no future/provider certification. Near ties mean a funding-time interval includes zero; costs can differ. Point-estimate Pareto membership is unchanged.
calculations.tie_behavior: Exact cost/time ties all remain; ascending candidate SHA-256 is presentation only
